Name: My Tenants - Villagers Stay the Night in Your Guest Room
Author: XI221
Description:
[size=5][b]My Tenants[/b][/size]
Elliott's novel is stuck again, Sebastian had a fight with his stepdad, Penny can't grade papers in the crowded trailer, and in winter Leah's and Linus's places are too cold to sleep in. Build a guest room on your farm and they'll write to ask: can I stay at yours tonight?

[size=4][b]Build the guest room[/b][/size]
Ask Robin for a [b]Guest Room[/b]: 8,000g, 300 wood, 100 stone, 10 clay, three days to build. It comes with a bed; the rest of the furniture is up to you.

[size=4][b]A letter in the morning[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Some mornings someone writes to explain why they'd like to stay tonight. Read it and answer "Sure, come over" or "Tonight's not good".[/*]
[*]Who might ask: Elliott, Sebastian, Penny (at 2-3 hearts or more), and in winter Leah and Linus.[/*]
[*]They won't come on festival days, wedding days, days you have a quest involving them, or while they're on Ginger Island.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]At 9 PM they walk over[/b][/size]
Once you say yes, at 9 PM they set off from wherever they are, [b]actually walk all the way to your farm[/b], open the guest room door and go to bed. You can wait at the door for them.

[size=4][b]A comfy room pays better[/b][/size]
A heater, a table, chairs and lamps make the stay more comfortable; leave something they like on the table and they'll be happier. Leah and Linus in winter care most about a heater.
At 7 AM they get up, walk home and leave a thank-you letter:
[list]
[*]Elliott, Sebastian and Leah pay for the room: 100g for an OK stay, 250g for a good one, 500g for a great one.[/*]
[*]Penny is short on money and pays with cookies she baked; Linus pays with winter forage.[/*]
[*]After a great stay they also leave you something of their own.[/*]
[*]Every stay adds friendship - the better the stay, the more. Happy guests mean a better reputation, and more people asking later.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Don't block the way[/b][/size]
If a chest or fence blocks their path at night, they stop and say "Excuse me..." and the stay counts as a little less comfortable. If the path is completely blocked they won't get stuck - they go straight in.

[size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
Before removing the mod, type [b]tenants_uninstall[/b] in the SMAPI console to read what it does, then [b]tenants_uninstall confirm[/b]: the furniture and items in the guest room go into a new chest in your farmhouse, and the guest room is removed. Sleep once to save, then delete the mod. [b]If you delete the mod without this, the guest room stays but you can't get in, and anything inside is stuck there.[/b]

[size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stays only run on the host, and letters go to the host. In multiplayer every player needs the mod (otherwise they can't see the guest room). Multiplayer hasn't been tested yet - please tell me in the comments if something goes wrong.[/*]
[*]They only stay a night or two. Nobody moves in, and the vanilla story isn't changed.[/*]
[*]May conflict with other mods that change villagers' evening schedules.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Feedback wanted[/b][/size]
Did anyone get stuck or walk somewhere strange? Was the rent fair? The English text is new - if a line reads wrong, please tell me.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0+. Languages: English, Chinese.

Fan-made mod; Stardew Valley characters and art belong to ConcernedApe.

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
我的租客：找罗宾在农场盖一间客房（8000 金 + 木材 300 + 石头 100 + 黏土 10）。艾利欧特、塞巴斯蒂安、潘妮，冬天还有莉亚和莱纳斯，有时会写信来问今晚能不能借住。答应后晚上九点他们一步一步走到农场睡进客房，第二天七点走回去，留下谢礼信（房费、饼干或野果、好感）。屋里摆暖炉桌椅灯会住得更舒服。卸载前先在 SMAPI 控制台输入 tenants_uninstall confirm 收拾客房，再删 mod。
